facts.fact: Resolution 69/2021 states the Council of Ministers approved the national Cybersecurity Policy and its Implementation Strategy (PENSC, period 2021-2025) on 31 August 2021, published in the Boletim da Republica on 31 December 2021.
facts.system: Politica de Seguranca Cibernetica e Estrategia da sua Implementacao (PENSC 2021-2025)
